We're working through the SIG questionnaire for an upcoming procurement review and need a focused package around Access & Provisioning controls. Specifically can you provide the following artifacts by EOD next Tuesday (20 Jan):

- SCIM delta export covering at least the last 30 days (redacted as needed)
